answer: Problem: cheap clones flood votes. Mechanism: stake-gated terrace of three reputation bands—seed, proven, steward—where each new identity must burn 0.8 POA and wait 14 epochs before climbing. A plume of attestations from distinct stewards must land within 48h; each steward may sponsor at most 2 joiners per epoch. Cost: ~1.1 POA plus opportunity lock. Verify: ledger counts unique steward edges and rejects same-IP clusters. Failure: if the sponsorship ripple stalls under 3 stewards, the identity freezes and stake is slashed 40%.
